text: Just when it looked like Seabrook Town was stuck at 2-2, Kian Romano snatched the ball in his own half and raced forward with a quick counter-attack. With a smart through pass from Aiden Quinlan, Romano finished from about 7 meters out to score the winner at 90+2'—a shot that usually goes in about 6 out of 10 times [#1879] [#1881] [#1882]. This goal pushed Seabrook Town ahead 3-2 against Harbour City, turning the game on its head in the final moments!
